ThingDef.Name: RR_NetworkMealBase
ThingDef.description: A larger serving of nutrient paste drawn from a food network. Its ingredient, spoilage and poisoning state comes from the source batch.

ThingDef.label: large network paste meal
ThingDef.description: Large meal: 1.8 nutrition and 1.8 stomach volume at 1x. Whole items are consumed; unusable portions are wasted.

ThingDef.label: feast-sized network paste meal
ThingDef.description: Feast-sized meal: 3.6 nutrition and 3.6 stomach volume at 1x. Whole items are consumed; unusable portions are wasted.

ThingDef.label: enormous network paste meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 4 nutrition and 4 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.

ThingDef.label: massive network paste meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 6 nutrition and 6 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.

ThingDef.label: colossal network paste meal
ThingDef.description: Legacy oversized stock: 15 nutrition and 15 stomach volume at 1x. Retained for existing saves. New cooking uses Standard, Large and Feast portions; old bills produce matching Feast batches.
